name: Probe results rejected on review
description: Companies whose probe found a live board that belongs to somebody else, or that duplicate a company already listed. Slugs are first-come-first-served, so a board answering is not proof it is the company we meant — every one of these returned real postings. Recorded rather than deleted so the same false positive is not rediscovered and shipped next time.
